questions.question: Compare batch culture and continuous culture.
questions.solution_html:
• Compare batch culture and continuous culture
  • Batch culture: Closed system; nutrients added once; shows all growth phases. ((1.5marks))
  • Continuous culture: Open system; fresh medium added continuously; cells remain in log
  • phase.
  • Used for industrial production.((1.5marks))

questions.question: How does low temperature methods preserve food, and what are the key differences between chilling and freezing?
questions.solution_html:
• Low temperature preservation & differences
  • Low temperature slows enzymes and microbial growth. ((2marks))
  • Chilling: 0–5°C, short-term storage, microbes slowed.((2marks))
  • Freezing: below -18°C, long-term storage, microbes almost stopped.((2marks))
  • Freezing forms ice crystals and may affect texture.((2marks))
questions.final_answer: Freezing forms ice crystals and may affect texture.()
